evidence.quote: The master rods were used to prepared single crystals by zone-melting unidirectional so- lidification in a XLL 500 furnace with a pulling rate of 10 mm/h. The furnace chamber was ﬁrst pumped to 2 310 23 Pa, followed by backﬁlling high-purity argon gas to 0.53105 Pa.
Single-crystal samples of 3 3335m m3 for uniaxial compression experiments were cut by spark-cutting, with the long edge parallel to the growth direction.

Stabilities of phase trans- formation and SME were examined by cycling between 350 °C and room temperature up to 1000 times in a thermal-cycle furnace, model Sk2-6-12, staying at 350 °C for 10 min, and then wind-cooling to room temperature in 5 min.
In order to examine the SME, samples were precompressed to a speciﬁc strain at room temperature and then heated to 400 °C for recovery.

The compression curve of Ni 54Mn25Ga21 consists of three obvious stages that are associated with the elastic deformation of the multivariants, reorientation of martensitic variants and/or detwinning, and the elastic and plastic deformation of fully reoriented martensites.
